notes.title: NewTaskbar 1.2
notes.notes:
Welcome to the NewTaskbar 1.2 update

In this new version we are introducing a big new feature, this feature is called "Shelf", you can access your Shelf by using a new dedicated shortcut or by adding a new component named "Shelf button".

You can add existing or brand new applications in your Shelf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824232/9fdbd6c242fddae1930aeaa2acf2fe8d57fc0a9c.png[/img]

Along with this new feature we are bringing a new button to the application editor, the button is named "Round" and it will set the rounded corners boxes to 99
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824232/79b76ca4d484d3ec12406ef532096de42485cfde.png[/img]

We also added a new shortcut to hide the bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824232/720d8db51a1639e782de42f1abdd579f1fc31d73.png[/img]

We redesigned just a bit the context menu used in the settings window and in the nea Shelf feature

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824232/d5ba300ca28951e6f0d37c4c3b1700e06abff14b.png[/img]

And lastly, NewTaskbar is now caching all of the images it needs to work, this allow the program to reduce the loading times up to 60%.

Bug fixes :

Fixed a bug where multiples NewTaskbar icons could be seen in the Windows notifications/tray
Fixed a bug where the options "Always on screen" and "Always on top" could be enabled by changing the position x or y of the bar
Fixed a bug where the bar will use the Windows language rather than language selected by the user

Enjoy !

notes.title: NewTaskbar 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Changed the maximum components length from 16 to 20 characters


Bug fixes : 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where creating/editing any components would enable the 'Always on screen' and 'Always on top' features of the bar
[*]Fixed a bug where the Settings window wasn't opening at the center of the screens with a resolution inferior to 1920x1080
[*]NewTaskbar.exe will now properly close NTSteam.exe when exited
[*]Fixed a bug where clicking on a non application component while having unsaved settings could ask two times to confirm the action
[/list]

Enjoy !

notes.title: NewTaskbar 1.1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the NewTaskbar 1.1 update

In this update we added the new feature 'Display components name', the feature is located under Settings > Bar settings > Display components name.

Here is a demo of the feature
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824232/e0d513ab9bd5841821d57cef42ff14bfb8d416d7.gif[/img]

We also migrated from the .Net Framework 4.8 to the 4.7.2 to ensure a better compatibility with multiples Windows versions.

Bug fixes : 
NewTaskbar.exe will now automatically start NTSteam.exe if it wasn't started correctly
UI fixes

Enjoy !

notes.title: NewTaskbar 1.0.2
notes.notes:
In this update we changed how NewTaskbar interacts with Steam, following this update Steam won't be needed to use NewTaskbar.

We also adjusted the Settings window height and width to match with small or big monitors.


Enjoy !
